mapper.sql: SELECT m.*, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.avatar_url AS sender_avatar, receiver.username AS receiver_username, receiver.avatar_url AS receiver_avatar, ticket.event_name AS ticket_event_name FROM chat_message m JOIN user sender ON sender.id = m.sender_id JOIN user receiver ON receiver.id = m.receiver_id LEFT JOIN ticket ON ticket.id = m.ticket_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (ticket_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = #{partnerId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{partnerId} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT 300

SELECT t.partner_id, t.ticket_id, t.content AS last_message, t.create_time AS last_message_time, t.outgoing, t.unread, partner.username AS partner_username, partner.avatar_url AS partner_avatar, ticket.event_name AS ticket_event_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{userId} THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END AS partner_id, m.ticket_id, m.content, m.create_time, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS outgoing, SUM(CASE WHEN m.receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{userId} THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END) AS unread, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{userId} THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC ) AS rn FROM chat_message m WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} OR m.receiver_id = #{userId} ) t JOIN user partner ON partner.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN ticket ON ticket.id = t.ticket_id WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{partnerId} AND is_read = 0
